_published_faq.name: How do I add PEAK Account to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PEAK Account to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.peakaccount.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PEAK Account MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PEAK Account lists 33 MCP tools, including create_billing_note, create_billing_note_expense, create_contact, create_credit_note, create_credit_note_expense, create_expense, create_invoice, create_payment_method, create_product, create_purchase_order, create_quotation, and create_receipt.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PEAK Account?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PEAK Account in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does PEAK Account MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: PEAK Account requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PEAK Account is developed by PUUN Intelligent Co., Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
